annotations.title: What AI does in your sector

description: Describes how a specific type of UK firm uses AI: what gets drafted, chased or checked, what to look for in a tool, and the questions firms in that sector ask. Use when an owner or partner in accountancy, recruitment, a law firm, financial planning, insurance broking, an estate or letting agency, construction or a trade such as plumbing or electrical work asks how firms like theirs use AI. Use other for any other small business.

sector.description: The firm's sector. plumbing-electrical-and-other-trades = plumbers, electricians, heating engineers, window fitters and other trades working on customers' jobs; construction = contractors and construction groups bidding for projects; property = estate and letting agents; wealth-management = financial planners and IFAs. Use other if none fits.
